question: KV cache memory formula bytes per token LLM inference

sources.title: KV Cache Size: The Formula and GPU Memory per User
sources.snippet: What is the KV cache size formula? KV cache per token = 2 × layers × key-value heads × head size × bytes per number, all read from the model's config.json. For Qwen3-8B that is 2 × 36 × 8 × 128 × 2 = 147,456 bytes, 144 KiB a token, so a 32,768-token conversation needs about 4.5 GiB.

sources.title: KV cache size: the formula, per token, with examples | Tecyfy
sources.snippet: What is the formula for KV cache size? Bytes per token = 2 × layers × KV heads × head size × bytes per number. The 2 is one key and one value. Multiply by the tokens in the conversation and by the conversations held at once. Llama 3.3 70B: 2 × 80 × 8 × 128 × 2 = 327,680 bytes a token, so 32,768 tokens take 10.7 GB at 16-bit.
